 Nandyala District, Andhra Pradesh
 ...Respondent(S):
 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that
in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High
Court may be pleased topleased For the reasons stated in the
accompanying affidavit, it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be
pleased to pass an order or direction or Writ, more specifically one in
the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring proceedings bearing
reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-03-2021, passed by the
Sub-Collector Nandyal , i.e., Respondent Number 3 in rejecting the
payment of compensation for lands of the petitioner resumed for public
purpose on par with payment of Rs 5.50 Lakhs per acre as paid to
patta holders and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in
respect of the land holding of the petitioner resumed by the
respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the
honourable High Court of Andhra Pradesh in Mekala Pandu case and
and as confirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal
No 7904-7912 dated 04- 08-2014 and consequently direct payment
of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of
the petitioner of Ac 1.33 Cents of land in survey No. 680/2 of
gani village, gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District, Ap duly duly setting
aside the orders bearing reference number Rc.B.238/2018 dated 09-

 Writ Petition No.32589 of 2023
Order:

Learned counsel for petitioner appeared virtually and submitted that in view of amendment issued vide G.O.Ms.No.23, Revenue (Lands.I), dated 19.01.2024, the Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023, this writ petition has been rendered infructuous.

entities.text: Andhra Pradesh Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) (Amendment) Act, 2023
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Recording the said submissions, the present Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous.

However,
petitioner is at liberty to initiate appropriate proceedings, if necessary.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any shall stands closed.

_ JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO Date:
